Description
Elevate your lifestyle with this exceptional townhome situated in an exclusive, upscale neighbourhood. Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of an expansive rooftop deck, perfect for entertaining or simply savouring the picturesque vistas where breathtaking water, city, and mountain views await. Step into the private master suite offers a retreat-like ambiance with its spacious layout, walk-in closet, and lavish bathroom featuring a soaker tub and separate shower. Maple hardwood floors and stylish glass railings enhance the home's elegance, while the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances, ensures a seamless culinary experience.

Description
Stunning UNFURNISHED 4 bdrm, 3 bath house in prestigious Mackenzie Heights offering 3,100 sq ft of exceptional Westside living w/ panoramic city, ocean & mountain views from every level. Bright, spacious living & dining rms feature floor-to-ceiling windows & gas f/p. Well-appointed kitchen w/ granite countertops, Fhiaba fridge, dual AEG wall ovens, cooktop, large island & eating area. Floor-to-ceiling folding doors open to sunny south-facing patio & terrace. Generously sized master bdrm w/ fabulous views, walk-in closet & ensuite w/ separate shower & soaker tub. Large office w/ panoramic views & gas f/p ideal for work-from-home. Two additional bdrms & full bath on upper level. Rental includes: Garage. Pets upon approval.
